title: DeepSeek V4 Matches Claude Opus
description:
Comment DEEPSEEK and I'll send you the link.

If you use AI in your work every day, save this. DeepSeek just dropped V4 — the open-source model from China now matches Claude Opus on quality, but through the API it costs 20 times less.

If you run your workflow with AI tools, work with long documents, automate marketing and social, or vibe-code your own apps, you'll pay 20x less for the same result. And the best part — you can plug it into the tools you already use, like Claude Code, in a couple of minutes.

#ai #deepseek #ecommerce #aitools #claudecode
